rows.label: Costs of earning income (koszty uzyskania przychodu) (reduces the tax base)
Pension contribution (employer), paid on top by the employer
Disability contribution (employer), paid on top by the employer
Accident insurance (wypadkowa), paid on top by the employer
Labour Fund (Fundusz Pracy), paid on top by the employer
Solidarity Fund (Fundusz Solidarnościowy), paid on top by the employer
Guaranteed Employee Benefits Fund (FGŚP), paid on top by the employer

notes: Verification (official-example): Checked against an official worked example. The golden tests reproduce the government business portal's (biznes.gov.pl) 2026 worked example for the minimum wage: employee contributions, health contribution, tax advance and net pay within 1 złoty, and the employer's contributions and total cost. https://www.biznes.gov.pl/pl/portal/0083
Salary paid monthly in 12 equal payments (no statutory 13th month for private-sector employees).
Employment contract (umowa o pracę) with one employer, the tax scale, PIT-2 filed (the tax-reducing amount applied), standard costs of earning income for one employment.
Annual figures for a salary paid evenly over the year; the monthly tax advance is rounded to whole złoty on the payslip, so a month can differ by under 1 złoty.
The employer pays the Labour Fund and Solidarity Fund (pay at or above the minimum wage) and takes part in no PPK contributions.

Not modelled: Employee capital plans (PPK) contributions, which are voluntary for the employee; The PIT-0 exemptions (under 26, return relief, families with 4+ children, working seniors); Author's costs (50%), joint filing with a spouse and child relief; Contracts of mandate (umowa zlecenie) and specific-task contracts.
